resource_definitions.seconds: wall time for construction/explanation/returned diagnostics; excludes fitting and tracemalloc
resource_definitions.predict_api_calls: observed public model.predict invocations during the operation; not arithmetic operations
resource_definitions.predict_api_rows: rows passed to observed model.predict calls
resource_definitions.peak_traced_bytes: peak tracemalloc allocations in a separate rerun; excludes already-fitted model and untraced native memory

variability: Five run means; synthetic datasets are regenerated; diabetes splits overlap; SD is not a confidence interval.
